code: local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScreenGui") local o={} for _,k in ipairs({"TutorialStep","GuideOff","ProfileReady"}) do table.insert(o,k.."="..tostring(p:GetAttribute(k))) end local c=p.Character table.insert(o,"cape="..tostring(c and c:GetAttribute("OpeningCapeState"))) for _,sg in ipairs(p.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") then table.insert(o,sg.Name.." enabled="..tostring(sg.Enabled).." overview="..tostring(sg:GetAttribute("TutorialOverviewDone"))) end end return table.concat(o," ")

local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local o={} for _,d in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and d.AbsolutePosition.Y<2000 then local t=d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Text or "" local par=d.Parent and d.Parent.Name or "" table.insert(o,string.format("%s|%s|%s|par=%s|%d,%d|%dx%d",d.ClassName,d.Name,t,par,d.AbsolutePosition.X,d.AbsolutePosition.Y,d.AbsoluteSize.X,d.AbsoluteSize.Y)) end end return table.concat(o,"\n")
